stories.title: Lei Seca: venda de bebidas alcoólicas nas Eleições 2026 não será proibida na Paraíba

en.title: Dry Law: sale of alcoholic beverages in 2026 Elections will not be prohibited in Paraíba
en.summary: Paraíba's security authorities confirmed that alcoholic beverage sales will not be banned during the 2026 general elections in the state. The regional electoral tribunal also reported no dry law measures are currently planned.

stories.title: Governo Trump destina US$ 1 milhão a projeto que se opõe à atuação do STF no Brasil, diz jornal

en.title: Trump Government allocates US$ 1 million to project that opposes STF's actions in Brazil, says newspaper
en.summary: The Trump administration reportedly allocated one million dollars to a project opposing the Brazilian Supreme Court's actions.

stories.title: Exposição com figurinos de Ney Matogrosso, concerto de Pepe Rivero e estreia de 'Verity': veja a agenda cultural

en.title: Exhibition with Ney Matogrosso costumes, Pepe Rivero concert and 'Verity' premiere: see the cultural agenda
en.summary: A cultural guide highlights weekend events in central-western São Paulo, including an exhibition featuring costumes, a concert performance, and film premieres available for public enjoyment.

stories.title: Procurador-Geral da Bolívia é preso por suspeita de lavagem de dinheiro e tráfico de drogas

en.title: Attorney General of Bolivia is arrested on suspicion of money laundering and drug trafficking
en.summary: Bolivia's Attorney General was arrested based on allegations involving money laundering and drug trafficking activities.

stories.title: Defesa cita novos fatos e pede revisão da condenação de Bolsonaro

en.title: Defense cites new facts and requests review of Bolsonaro's conviction
en.summary: The defense team of former president Jair Bolsonaro filed a request for criminal review seeking to overturn his 27-year and three-month prison sentence for leading a coup attempt. The lawyers also requested immediate suspension of the sentence while the review is pending judgment.

stories.title: Santos regulariza ocupação do Centro de Treinamento Rei Pelé

en.title: Santos regularizes use of Rei Pelé Training Center
en.summary: The federal government and Santos Football Club signed an agreement for the regularization of the Rei Pelé Training Center in Santos, São Paulo. The deal grants a 20-year paid concession, renewable for an equal period, with monthly payments of R$ 145,167.42.

stories.title: Lula assina cessão onerosa de terreno do centro de treinamento do Santos

en.title: Lula signs paid transfer of Santos training center land
en.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the paid transfer of the land where the Rei Pelé training center is located. The property covers approximately 39,000 square meters in the coastal city of Santos, São Paulo.

stories.title: Governo Lula assina concessão de CT Rei Pelé ao Santos por 40 anos

en.title: Lula government signs concession of Rei Pelé CT to Santos for 40 years
en.summary: The Lula government signed a concession agreement for the Rei Pelé training center to Santos for 40 years.

stories.title: São Paulo tem três novos casos de sarampo; total chega a 40 este ano

en.title: São Paulo has three new measles cases; total reaches 40 this year
en.summary: São Paulo state confirmed four new measles cases, bringing the 2026 total to 40. Three of the newly diagnosed patients reside in the capital, including two men aged 18 and 21 and a one-year-old girl.

stories.title: Com três novos casos de sarampo em São Paulo, estado vai a 40

en.title: With three new measles cases in São Paulo, state reaches 40
en.summary: São Paulo state reached 40 measles cases without any deaths. The three new cases involved two men aged 18 and 21 and a one-year-old girl, all from the capital and linked to transmission chains identified since June.

stories.title: Anne Hathaway comanda fotográfos em estreia de 'Verity'; veja vídeo

en.title: Anne Hathaway directs photographers at 'Verity' premiere; see video
en.summary: Anne Hathaway, 43, drew attention during the premiere of her new film 'Verity' by directing photographers and cast members on how to pose for photographs.

stories.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro pede liberdade do ex-presidente com base em sessão sobre Moraes

en.title: Bolsonaro's defense seeks release of former president based on Moraes session
en.summary: Bolsonaro's legal team requested the former president's release from Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, arguing that investigations into an alleged coup plot were initiated by Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

stories.title: Blackstone cria empresa de tecnologia de defesa para combater ameaça de drones de baixo custo

en.title: Blackstone creates defense technology company to combat low-cost drone threat
en.summary: Blackstone announced it is investing in a new defense technology company aimed at neutralizing threats from the proliferation of low-cost drones.

stories.title: Mercados de títulos estão operando de maneira ordenada, diz FMI

en.title: Bond markets operating orderly, says IMF
en.summary: The International Monetary Fund stated that global bond markets are functioning in an orderly manner despite recent sharp increases in yields that have driven worldwide financing costs to multi-decade highs.

stories.title: Produção de calçados deve cair 2,1% em 2026, pressionada por importados

en.title: Footwear production expected to decline 2.1% in 2026, pressured by imports
en.summary: Brazil's footwear industry association revised its 2026 production forecast from a projected 0.1% increase to a 2.1% decline, citing pressure from imported goods. Production is expected to total between 822.9 and 837.3 million pairs.

stories.title: Dólar sobe mais de 1%, juros futuros avançam e Ibovespa cai com aversão global a risco

en.title: Dollar rises over 1%, future interest rates advance, and Ibovespa falls amid global risk aversion
en.summary: The U.S. dollar, Treasury yields, and oil prices strengthened while Brazilian equity and currency markets declined. Global risk aversion, inflationary concerns, and crude oil volatility pressured the Ibovespa and Brazilian real.

stories.title: SpaceX lança 13ª tripulação de astronautas para missão de longa duração na Estação Espacial Internacional

en.title: SpaceX launches 13th astronaut crew for long-duration mission to International Space Station
en.summary: SpaceX launched a Falcon 9 rocket from Florida carrying four crew members—two American astronauts, one Canadian astronaut, and one Russian cosmonaut—to the International Space Station for a scientific mission focused on human health and orbital performance.
